feats.title: Disheartening Presence
feats.description: While you are conscious and not bloodied, bloodied enemies adjacent to you take a -1 penalty to attack rolls.

feats.title: Improved Cunning
feats.description: When you use Virtue of Cunning to slide an ally, you can slide the ally 2 squares instead of 1.

feats.title: Improved Valor
feats.description: The number of temporary hit points granted by your Virtue of Valor increases by 3.

feats.title: Majestic Rescue
feats.description: When you use majestic word, you can grant the target a saving throw in addition to the other effects of the power.

feats.title: Prescient Aid
feats.description: When an ally within 10 squares of you misses with an attack roll, you can use your Virtue of Prescience as an immediate interrupt. That ally gains a power bonus to the attack roll equal to your Wisdom.

feats.title: Walk Among the Fey
feats.description: Whenever you use a power that slides a creature, you can teleport that creature an equal number of squares instead. Where you teleport the creature remains subject to any restrictions on the original slide.
